commands.review_summary:
The branch replaces direct Canvas A2UI JSONL file reads with a bounded reader shared by the CLI and agent tool, with tests for oversized inputs and a payload above the former 8 MiB branch limit.

PR surface: Source +43, Tests +104. Total +147 across 6 files.

Reproducibility: no. executed current-main reproduction was established in this read-only review, but the changed source path and Gateway protocol contract make the framing mismatch source-reproducible. A near-25 MiB JSONL file with normal JSON quoting is the focused case to verify against a live Gateway.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A Canvas/Gateway owner must choose the user-facing large-payload compatibility contract before a repair can safely set a permanent limit and proof target.
